checklists.name: Oracle Database Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for PL/SQL development, Oracle performance tuning, security, and high availability.

items.statement: PL/SQL procedures and packages enforce strict exception handling and avoid silent WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL clauses.
SQL queries use bind variables exclusively to prevent SQL injection and maximize SGA library cache cursor sharing.
Query execution plans are analyzed via EXPLAIN PLAN / AUTOTRACE to verify index usage and avoid unexpected full table scans.
Tables and indexes specify appropriate tablespaces, partitioning strategies, and storage parameters.
Data Guard failover compatibility and RAC node connection load balancing are validated for mission-critical schemas.

obligationDefinitions.title: Oracle Database must be patched against known CVEs on the vendor's quarterly cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: Oracle publishes a Critical Patch Update quarterly; a database instance left unpatched past a CPU release carries known, disclosed vulnerabilities. Patch application must be tracked against the CPU release schedule, not applied ad hoc.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every Oracle instance is patched to within one CPU cycle of the current release.

requiredEvidence.title: CPU patch currency record
requiredEvidence.description: Database patch inventory compared against the current Oracle CPU release.
